name: framer-thumnbails

frames.best_why: Full green sunlit wall photo with both arrows and the widened thumbnail in the rail below.

tagline: Tap a thin preview to widen it and swap the big photo.
summary: A large photo sits above a single rail of small previews, where the current one is three times wider than the rest. Choosing a preview widens it, slides the rail and springs the big picture across.
appearance: A big rounded photo about 400px tall, with a hairline white chevron circle over each side. Underneath runs one tight row of eighteen upright preview strips about 70px tall; one is clearly wider, roughly three strips' worth, and the rest are narrow slivers.
behaviour: Picking a sliver grows it into the wide slot while its neighbours shrink, and the row scrolls itself so the chosen preview sits near the middle. The large photo follows with a spring, and dragging it sideways navigates the same way.
demo_content: Eighteen Unsplash photos: a sunglasses portrait, a sunlit green wall, a blurred figure and a paraglider over sky.
search_phrases: wide photo with strip of small previews
click a thumbnail to enlarge the picture
photo slider with narrow preview strips
big image above a row of tiny pictures
use_when: One image should dominate while every other option stays visible as a sliver beneath it.
avoid_when: The photo area is fixed at 400px tall and all eighteen pictures load as previews at once.
customise: Pictures come from the items array in the file; the open and closed preview widths plus the photo height are constants to edit.
weight_why: One sliding strip and a width change on eighteen small previews; idle when untouched.

a11y.note: Preview buttons take their name from odd image titles, and no custom focus ring is supplied.

issues: The same made-up titles such as 'SONYPOO' are used as alt text on each photo.
All eighteen previews share one row, leaving each sliver too narrow to aim at.
polish_why: The expanding preview and centred scroll feel considered; the cramped rail is the weak point.
title: Framer Thumbnail Carousel
